source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Run command: ipmitool chassis power reset
2. After system is power on and boot into OS,
Run command: ipmitool chassis power status, make sure the power status is off

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. All steps reponse are correct.
2. System can power reset normally.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" chassis power reset 2>&1; echo ---status-after---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" chassis status 2>&1
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: BEFORE state = `chassis status`; after `power reset`, a second `chassis status` confirms; operator confirms (operator-triggered, PARTIAL).
deepseek_columns.risk: STATE-CHANGING: drives chassis power over OOB IPMI; approval required (R6/R22); keep PARTIAL; never auto-run.

original_test_intent: Verify a chassis reset causes the intended reset/boot transition and healthy OS recovery, but the preserved source does not define a logically consistent final power state.
original_method: Do not execute until the owner selects the authoritative observation point and final state. After correction, use one approved reset with workload protection, canonical transition polling, console/OS/health recovery and no automatic retry.
manual_activity: Engineer must decide whether acceptance is an intermediate off phase followed by ON/boot-ready, or a final OFF state; those cannot both be final. Operator authorization and recovery design follow only after that decision.
required_inputs: Reset semantics and canonical state enum
safety_requirements: Do not execute the current contradictory version.
Do not clear logs, expose credentials or interrupt workloads.
Do not infer reset success from command response or one status sample.
No repeated reset or alternative power action as recovery.
Preserve all source wording and correction decision.
After correction require explicit approval and one-attempt limit.
agent_execution_scope: Static analysis and evidence-plan drafting only while blocked.
After a separately approved correction, capture baseline, issue one reset and monitor the defined timeline.
Verify canonical power, console, OS and health checkpoints.
Return evidence without retry or verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve the final-state contradiction and observation point.
Approve workload, timeout, recovery and final state.
Authorize any corrected execution and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Must not run: it leaves the acceptance contradiction unresolved, uses password arguments and broad status output, and lacks workload/boot/recovery controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No executable command is recommended until engineer correction; then use a protected one-reset workflow with canonical polling and boot-health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Reset command, boot-into-OS wording, off-status wording, Script, Criteria and 5/10-minute values are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correct the final-state timeline, then re-review one interlocked reset/recovery workflow.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Not executable until owner correction; afterward only the exact approved SUT/BMC.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pin BMC/IPMI, parser and Script after correction.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-approved reset semantics and Project boot/recovery criteria.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Preserves the contradiction instead of guessing and adds workload, state-timeline, health and recovery requirements.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No read-only or status-only evidence can satisfy the reset function; current coverage is zero until correction/execution.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Authoritative final state/timeline and full safety contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Reset can interrupt workloads, corrupt data and strand a failed boot.

project_override_considerations: A different reset tool requires approval and equivalent reset/boot coverage only after the source acceptance is resolved; no tool override may guess the final state.
expected_evidence: Engineer contradiction resolution and corrected timeline
Explicit approval, target and workload-safe baseline
Protected reset response and timestamped transition
No-clear/no-retry audit, approved final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master says the system is powered on and booted into OS, then requires power status off. Without a defined intermediate observation point these outcomes cannot both be the final acceptance state.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core expected result is contradictory; Project inputs cannot select a safe PASS state without an engineer decision.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects execution before contradiction correction and adds missing safety controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Adopts its execution hold but classifies the unresolved core semantic conflict as BLOCKED.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Overrides generic operator-gated execution because pass/fail is undefined.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps reset distinct and flags the same issue for the following power-cycle case.

review_improvement: Prevents a destructive reset from running against an impossible final-state criterion and records explicit engineer ownership.
independent_technical_reasoning: A reset may briefly remove power/availability before returning ON, but a host booted into OS cannot simultaneously have final chassis power OFF. Timing could reconcile the statements only if the owner defines intermediate versus final checkpoints; inventing that timeline would be an unauthorized semantic change.
